meta.name: DMA engine
meta.description: A memory-copy engine of a SoC: a program sets a source, a destination and a length in its registers and starts it; on every rising clock edge it moves up to "burst size" words between its source and destination buses, and its IRQ pin can signal the end

bus.label: Control bus
bus.title: The SoC bus the DMA's registers answer on; the transfers use it too unless a source or destination bus is chosen

startAddress.label: Base address (hex)
startAddress.title: Address of the first register (word-aligned: the low two bits are cleared); the DMA answers 24 bytes from there (word access only)

burstSize.label: Burst size (words/tick)
burstSize.title: Most words moved on one rising clock edge

srcBus.label: Source bus
srcBus.title: The SoC bus the words are read from (hidden reads, not in the bus trace); unset: the control bus

dstBus.label: Destination bus
dstBus.title: The SoC bus the words are written to (visible writes: a VGA screen on that bus sees them); unset: the control bus

cExport.label: C header
cExport.title: Writes a C driver for this DMA: <NAME>.h and <NAME>.c with the register addresses, the CONTROL / STATUS bits, a setter / getter per register and helpers to start a transfer, wait for it and clear DONE

status.label: Status
status.title: The address range the DMA answers, the buses it moves data on and its register values

status.notConnected: Not connected to a control bus: choose one in the Control bus attribute

cExport.generated: Logic Design Studio automatically generated file for a DMA component
cExport.addresses:
Addresses of this DMA engine. It moves up to {{burst}} words on every rising clock edge.
All registers take word accesses only.
cExport.registerFunctions:
With the following functions the registers can be set or read out.
The addresses and the length are in bytes, the low two bits are ignored;
writes to SRC_ADDR, DST_ADDR and LENGTH are ignored while a transfer runs.
BYTES_DONE can only be read.
cExport.start:
With the following function a transfer of "length" bytes from "src" to "dst" is started.
"flags" are CONTROL bits (IRQ_EN, DST_FIXED, SRC_FIXED); START is added.
Nothing starts while a transfer runs, or when "length" is below 4 or 2^31 or more.
cExport.busy: The following function returns 1 while a transfer runs, else 0.
cExport.clearDone: With the following function the DONE bit and the interrupt are cleared.
cExport.wraps: The DMA registers at base address {{start}} go past 0xFFFFFFFF: choose a base address of 0xFFFFFFE8 or lower

circ.idTooLong: The control bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the DMA is not connected to a control bus
circ.srcIdTooLong: The source bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the DMA reads from its control bus
circ.dstIdTooLong: The destination bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the DMA writes to its control bus
circ.badStartAddress: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit base address: 0x0 is used
circ.badBurstSize: "{{value}}" is not a burst size: {{used}} words/tick is used
circ.burstSizeRounded: The burst size "{{value}}" is not one of 1, 2, 4 … 256: {{used}} words/tick is used, as Logisim-evolution does
